steps.speaker: Mira
steps.title: Your Roster
steps.body:
Here's your full roster. Add heroes to your party, then assign them a formation row — Front, Middle, or Back.

Front row heroes get targeted first by melee attacks, so put your toughest fighters there. Ranged and support heroes are safer in the Back.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.title: Gear and Bags
steps.body:
Use Manage Gear to equip weapons, armor, and accessories. You can also equip a backpack in the Bag slot to carry more items.

Below the equipment you'll see your hero's bag inventory — fill it with consumables like potions before heading into the dungeon. Preparation saves lives.
